standard-dialogue-before-the-player-has-.player: I didn't know dwarves kept cats.

standard-dialogue-before-the-player-has-.npc: Friend of mine lives at the palace, actually. Well, I say friend. Used to be a friend.
He got adopted by Hreidmar. The director of the Red Axe.
I don't like the Red Axe! They stomp around everywhere, got to be careful of your tail with those people around.

standard-dialogue-when-the-player-tries-.speaker: Cat
standard-dialogue-when-the-player-tries-.text: Get your hands off that, you dirty human!

standard-dialogue-when-the-player-tries-.speaker: Dromund
standard-dialogue-when-the-player-tries-.text: Stay away from there! Who do you think you are, coming into my house like that?
You don't think you'll be able to get close to this boot without the old dwarf noticing you, what with his cat guarding.

standard-dialogue-after-the-player-has-g.npc: I know what you did, [player name]!
You stole a boot from my master.
